target: acceptance 3 — near-duplicates are a JUDGMENT: reported as numbered candidates for a human, never merged. Asserts the parsed candidate COUNT and a numbered candidate block, because the summary line contains the word 'candidate(s)' even when the count is zero.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/near_dupes.md" t.md; a=$(cksum < t.md); o=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" consolidate t.md 2>&1); b=$(cksum < t.md); [ "$a" = "$b" ] && same=1 || same=0; n=$(printf "%s" "$o" | sed -nE "s/.*; ([0-9]+) near-duplicate candidate\(s\) reported.*/\1/p" | head -1); blk=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -c "^  candidate 1:"); lines=$(grep -c "shim timeout" t.md); printf '{"unchanged":%s,"count":%s,"block":%s,"bothKept":%s}' "$same" "${n:-0}" "$blk" "$lines"
